description:
Configure the 'example-repo-local' repository to strictly enforce namespace governance. Modify the repository settings so that it ONLY accepts artifacts uploaded to the 'com/acme/**' path. Any uploads to other paths (e.g., 'org/...') must be rejected. 

Steps:
1. Log in to Artifactory (http://localhost:8082) as 'admin' with password 'password'.
2. Navigate to Administration > Repositories > Local.
3. Edit 'example-repo-local'.
4. Change the 'Includes Pattern' to strictly match 'com/acme/**'.
5. Save the repository.
